labor.basis: Hours scaled 0.8x to match actual hours on same-scope accepted quotes (2026-10-10). 129 Livewire network-only quotes since 2024: median 6 labor hours at a median of 3 network devices; the Basic Network Package carries 5 hours. 3 hours plus 0.5 per device gives 6 hours for a typical 6-device job. Refit 2026-10-10 by non-negative least squares on 84 accepted network quotes (outliers trimmed; holdout median labor error 67% to 34%): 1 hour of setup on an add-on visit, eero 1, wired AP 1.25, outdoor AP 3.75, switch 1.75, WattBox 2.25 hours

assumptions: The internet service provider's modem or ONT is in place; the first eero node connects to it.
Existing Cat6 is usable for wired access points; new cable runs are verified on site.
Quantities marked as minimums are confirmed during a site visit.
exclusions: New Cat6 cable runs unless listed.
